query:
WITH 90 AS stale_days
MATCH (u:User)-[:HasProfileArtifact]->(a:ProfileArtifact)-[fo:FoundOn]->(c:Computer)
WHERE fo.newestmodified IS NOT NULL AND fo.newestmodified < (datetime().epochSeconds - (stale_days * 86400))
RETURN u.name AS User, a.artifacttype AS ArtifactType, a.category AS Category, c.name AS Computer, fo.profilepaths AS ProfilePaths, fo.newestmodified AS NewestModified, fo.findingids AS FindingIds
ORDER BY NewestModified ASC
name: Profilehound - Stale Profile Artifact Review
description: Lists artifact evidence that has not been modified within the configured number of days.
